catalog.applies_to: Nous Research as the creator of the Hermes model families it trains and announces.

notes: Human origin approval only. It records where Nous Research publishes primary release information; it adds no creator, family, release, product or deployment to the dataset, and it does not make Nous Research a pilot creator.
huggingface.co is an already-trusted generic host reached at https://huggingface.co/NousResearch for the Hermes model cards; it is not re-approved here.

source_catalog.trust_notes: Nous Research's official releases index; authoritative for its model release names and the dates it lists against them. Bounded to /releases, the section checked.
source_catalog.verification: Fetched 2026-08-30 (raw HTML): /releases returned HTTP 200 titled 'Releases - NOUS RESEARCH', carrying a server-rendered table whose MODEL row for 'Hermes-4-14B' lists the date 08/26/25, on the Nous-owned nousresearch.com host. The site metadata and footer both describe Nous Research as 'The AI accelerator company'.

deferred_origins.decision: already-trusted generic host, not re-approved here
deferred_origins.reason: Reached 2026-08-30 for the Hermes-4-14B model card (HTTP 200). huggingface.co is already a trusted origin through existing dataset sources, so it is noted rather than re-approved.

ambiguities.topic: The releases table MODEL row is the release, not the arXiv paper row
ambiguities.note: The /releases table carries separate rows for a model and its paper; Hermes 4 has both a MODEL row (dated 08/26/25) and a paper reference to arXiv 2508.18255.
ambiguities.guidance: Take the dated MODEL row as the release date. An arXiv submission date is a fact about the paper, not the model release, and must not be substituted.

ambiguities.topic: Hermes-4-14B over Hermes-3-8B for a coherent licence
ambiguities.note: Hermes-3-8B's card carries only the bare slug 'license: llama3' while declaring base_model meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B, and its /raw/main/LICENSE returns HTTP 404; the slug and base disagree with nothing resolving it. Hermes-4-14B's card slug 'apache-2.0' and base Qwen/Qwen3-14B agree.
ambiguities.guidance: Prefer a release whose licence slug and stated base model agree. Do not record a licence a source contradicts.
